parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end time. This value is a UNIX timestamp in seconds.

parameters.name: IP
parameters.description: The IP address of the asset.

parameters.name: IsAITraffic
parameters.description: Specifies whether to collect only the traffic that accesses AI services. This parameter is required. Set this parameter to "true". Otherwise, a parameter error is returned.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the response. Valid values:

- **zh** (default): Chinese
- **en**: English

parameters.name: Order
parameters.description:
The sort field. Valid values:

- TotalBytes: sorts by total traffic.
- SessionCount: sorts by session count.

Default value: TotalBytes.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page.

parameters.name: Sort
parameters.description: The sort order. Valid values: asc, desc.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The start time. This value is a UNIX timestamp in seconds.

parameters.name: VpcId
parameters.description: The ID of the VPC where the asset resides.
